text: You snag your DAD'S PDA. Maybe later you'll switch the background image to something hilarious as a prank. Besides, it may come in handy later.
Your spare CAPTCHALOGUE CARD is forced out of the SYLLADEX, and consequently integrated with the deck. You now have five cards to work with.
alt: You captchalogue DAD'S PDA off of the table. The captchalogued captchalogue card turns into extra sylladex space.
